title: Reticle proxy network.websocket event payload
description: Typed shape of the payload carried by proxy-sourced network.websocket events: one frame observed on an open socket, or — with capReached — the notice that frames stopped being recorded. The socket's own upgrade is an ordinary network.request/network.response pair (status 101) under the same requestId; these carry what happened inside it. The host proxy is the sole producer.

requestId.description: The upgrade flow's id, so frames join their network.request.

frameIndex.description: Zero-based position in the frame sequence recorded for this socket. On the capReached notice, the number of frames recorded before it.

direction.description: Which way the frame travelled. 'none' on the capReached notice, which is not a frame.

kind.description: WebSocket opcode as a readable kind (RFC 6455 5.2). 'capReached' on the notice, which has no opcode.

isFinal.description: FIN bit — false for a fragment continued by later continuation frames.

bytes.description: Frame payload size on the wire.

textPreview.description: UTF-8 preview of a text frame, capped. Absent for a binary frame, which has no text reading. The whole payload is under the event's refs when it did not fit inline.

textPreviewTruncated.description: True when textPreview is a prefix of the frame rather than the whole of it.

capReached.description: Marks the one event announcing that no further frames on this socket will be recorded. The socket is still open and may still be talking — the silence that follows is the cap, not a quiet socket.

framesRecorded.description: Frames emitted as events before the cap. Present on the capReached notice.

framesNotRecorded.description: Frames the capture engine's own cap dropped, when it reported a count. Present on the capReached notice when known.
